lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters (~10-30 pixels in diameter) arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like matrix of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral surface, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 15 high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial frequency concentrated towards the anterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-luminance, elongated white linear feature is visible in the ventral-lateral region, distinct from the primary integumentary patterning.
